Decide what to automate, what to test by hand, and what risk is acceptable for each release. Automation that lasts. Build and extend API, UI and integration test suites that are fast, reliable and run in CI on every change. Shift left. Review designs and requirements early, and work with developers so testability is built in, not bolted on. Learn from escapes. Ownership, curiosity, and a willingness to learn. title: Senior Business Intelligence Developer
description: Business Unit: Cubic Transportation Systems Company Details: When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Job Details: Job Summary The Senior BI Developer is a senior technical leader within CTS’s Global Analytics function, based in the CDI team in Hyderabad. The role is the subject matter expert (SME) for Microsoft Power BI and owns the design, development and ongoing evolution of analytical assets - semantic data models, interactive dashboards, reports and data products - built on Power BI and backed by Azure SQL and Oracle data sources. Working closely with the UK-based BI Team Lead, Engineering and Services teams, the Senior BI Developer leads the end-to-end delivery of BI solutions for the TOC program and other global programs across domains such as ridership, sales, device performance and service operations. The role pairs deep technical skill with advanced UI/UX design capability, turning complex operational, performance and customer datasets into intuitive, visually polished analytical experiences that drive service excellence, contractual KPI/SLA compliance and continuous improvement. The role also provides technical mentoring to more junior developers in the team. This position works under general direction and takes ownership of deliverables with minimal supervision. Develop reusable analytical assets – certified datasets, templates, themes, KPI frameworks and metric definitions – that enable consistent, self-service analytics across programs. Optimize Power BI performance, including model design, DAX tuning, query folding, aggregations and capacity usage (e.g. using DAX Studio, Performance Analyzer). Manage workspaces, deployment pipelines, gateways, refresh schedules and governance practices in the Power BI Service. Dashboard & UI/UX Design Apply advanced UI/UX and data visualization design to create intuitive, accessible, on-brand dashboards, including custom layouts, themes (JSON), navigation, drill-through, bookmarks, tooltips and mobile views. Define and uphold dashboard design standards and storytelling best practice across the team. Build custom visuals and use tools such as Figma, Deneb/Vega or SVG-driven visuals where they add value (preferred). SQL Development & Data Integration Develop and maintain complex, performant SQL (T-SQL for Azure SQL / SQL Server and PL/SQL for Oracle), including stored procedures, views, functions, indexing and execution-plan tuning. Design and build data pipelines and transformations (e.g. Azure Data Factory, Power Query, SSIS) integrating data from multiple operational systems, ODS/EDW and customer sources. Design and maintain dimensional data models and analytical datasets that serve Power BI and other consumers. Perform data wrangling, cleansing, reconciliation and defect investigation to ensure reported figures are accurate, consistent and explainable. Data Analysis & Insights Conduct data analysis and deliver actionable insights to support project and BAU requirements across regional and global teams. Support root cause analysis (RCA), impact assessments and KPI/SLA performance monitoring through interactive dashboards. Provide scheduled and ad-hoc analysis and reporting to key business units, ensuring timely and accurate delivery. Requirements, Solution Design & Collaboration Participate in requirements gathering workshops with internal and external stakeholders (including UK-based customers and the BI Team Lead), translating business needs into well-defined technical specifications. Contribute to solution design and architecture decisions for new and existing BI environments, aligned to best practice and long-term scalability. Partner with Engineering and Services teams on data architecture and delivery. Champion BI development standards, including documentation, naming conventions, code review, testing and version control (e.g. Git, deployment pipelines). SAP BusinessObjects & Legacy Support (Secondary) Maintain and support existing SAP BusinessObjects solutions (WebI, Crystal Reports, universes via IDT) and SSRS reports where required. Support migration and rationalization of legacy reports onto Power BI, including gap analysis and validation against existing outputs. Support, Mentoring & Continuous Improvement Provide responsive production support for reporting and data issues, including incident triage, root cause analysis and resolution. Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior developers and analysts in the CDI team; review their work for quality. Identify and implement automation and process improvements that reduce manual reporting effort. Present analytical findings and solutions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including UK-based stakeholders. Comply with security in accordance with established policies and procedures of the organisation. Comply with Cubic Human Resources procedures. Other duties as requested. Required Skills and Qualifications Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Engineering, Mathematics or a related field. 6+ years’ experience in Business Intelligence related roles, with significant recent hands-on Power BI experience (data modelling, DAX, Power Query, Power BI Service). Strong SQL skills across both Azure SQL / SQL Server (T-SQL) and Oracle (PL/SQL), including query optimization and performance tuning. Proven ability to design and develop analytical assets (semantic models, certified datasets, KPI frameworks), not just consume them. Advanced dashboard UI/UX design skills, with a portfolio or demonstrable examples of polished, user-centered Power BI work. Strong understanding of relational database design and dimensional modelling. Strong background in RCA, impact analysis and operational performance analytics, and experience working with very large, multi-source datasets. Experience partnering with engineering teams on data architecture and delivery. Preferred Skills Experience with Azure data services (Azure Data Factory, Synapse, Fabric) and Microsoft BI tools (SSIS, SSAS, SSRS). Experience with AWS Experience with Python, R or machine learning; exposure to predictive maintenance or device health analytics. Power BI custom visuals, Tabular Editor, DAX Studio, Figma or equivalent design tooling; Git, DevOps and CI/CD data workflows. Microsoft certification (e.g. PL-300 Power BI Data Analyst, DP-500/DP-600) or working towards. Experience in a transportation, operations, SaaS or managed services environment; knowledge of ServiceNow data models. Experience with SAP BusinessObjects (WebI, Universes, Crystal Reports) – good to have; experience migrating from SAP BI to Power BI is a plus. Agile, ITIL and PRINCE2 experience. Soft Skills Strong analytical mindset with exceptional problem-solving abilities. Design sensibility and attention to detail, with a user-first approach to analytics. Ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables. Excellent communication skills – able to simplify complex concepts for non-technical stakeholders. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, global, multi-time zone team, including regular collaboration with UK colleagues. Proactive, resourceful and committed to high-quality outcomes. Role Impact & Success Measures The Senior BI Developer will directly support CTS’s global analytics capability and the TOC program by delivering high-quality, well-designed analytical assets and insights, strengthening KPI/SLA measurement and enabling data-driven decision-making. Concept designs come from many sources from standard prototypes to system rewrites, and our UX team makes sure they come together as consistent, usable products. As a UI/UX Designer III, you'll be the design-to-code partner for your engineering teams, helping make sure what ships matches both the visual design and the coded components of our design system. Day to day, that might mean reviewing a pull request, keeping Figma and code in step, untangling a tricky UI issue or writing the specs and agent instructions that help teams get the UI right the first time. Key Responsibilities: Leverage AI-assisted tooling (e.g., prompt-to-layout generators, Figma-to-code plugins, and coding agent integrations) to rapidly prototype and accelerate the design-to-development pipeline. Decide what belongs in Figma (exploration, intent, visual specs) and what should go straight to code through agents. Guide product teams on that split. Write and maintain specs, prompts, skills and agent instructions that lead AI coding tools to produce interfaces that follow the design system. Review pulls requests for UI accuracy, correct use of components and tokens, responsive behaviour and accessibility before merge. Keep design and code in sync so components and tokens stay consistent from design files to production, and every change traces back to its design source. Spot where generated code drifts from the design system, and feed fixes back into the components, the tokens or the agent instructions. Serve as the main UI design contact for assigned product and engineering teams. Partner with developers, and the agents they direct, to implement approved designs accurately. Give guidance on layouts, interactions, responsive behaviour and component usage. Troubleshoot UI implementation problems and recommend solutions that follow our design standards. Prepare clean, well-structured Figma files and clear technical specs that developers and AI agents can act on. Run UI audits to find visual inconsistencies, incorrect component usage and implementation gaps, then log defects and work with developers to resolve them. Find gaps in existing components and tokens and recommend improvements. Maintain UI guidelines, component usage docs and implementation standards in Confluence and in the repo, where agents can read them. Document design decisions, approved patterns and reusable fixes for recurring problems. Write design system release notes and tell development teams about component changes. Help educate engineering teams on design system standards and the agentic workflow. Experience integrating automated tests with CI/CD platforms such as GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins. Strong understanding of test design techniques, defect lifecycle, regression testing, integration testing, and risk-based testing. Strong debugging, root-cause analysis, and troubleshooting skills. We’re powered by our people – a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 167 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.

Consolidated revenues as of 12 months ending September 2026 totaled $14.8 billion. To learn how we can supercharge progress for you, visit hcltech.com.

title: Quality Assurance Tester - (Mobile Applications)
description: Position Overview Position Overview We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Mobile Applications Tester with hands-on experience testing Flutter-based mobile applications across Android and iOS platforms. The candidate will be responsible for validating application functionality, usability, performance, security, database integrity, API integrations, and overall application quality. The individual must be capable of independently reviewing business requirements, technical specifications, UI/UX mockups, and application workflows to develop comprehensive test strategies and execute test cases. Initially, the candidate will work independently with the development team to identify, document, troubleshoot, and verify application defects. Subsequently, the tester will collaborate closely with the Product Owner, Flutter Developer, and UI/UX Designer to ensure that the application meets business requirements and delivers a consistent, reliable user experience. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC), Agile methodologies, and modern AI-assisted software testing practices. 95% new development testing / 5% Regression Testing Hours per Week 20 hours ( US CST ) Work Location Remote (WFH - US CST ) - Must meet in-person with the management team in Hyderabad. Contract Term 1 Year with the option of extension Remuneration Probation - 4 months - Stipend -Rs 5,000.00 Fulltime Employment after probation - 10,000 to INR 15,000/Mth - DOE Client Expectation Perform the following testing activities: Functional Testing, Integration Testing, System Testing, Regression Testing, Smoke and Sanity Testing, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), UI/UX Testing, Compatibility Testing, Performance and Load Testing. API and Web Services Testing, Database Testing, Security Testing, Installation, Upgrade, and Deployment Testing. Additional Testing responsibilities: Validate application performance, responsiveness, stability, and resource utilization, Test application behavior under poor network conditions, intermittent connectivity, and offline scenarios, verify application recovery after crashes, interruptions, and unexpected shutdowns, Validate push notifications, SMS OTP, email notifications, and other integrated communication services where applicable. API and Database Testing Perform API testing using POSTMAN, Validate REST APIs, request/response structures, HTTP status codes, authentication, authorization, and error handling, Verify data communication between Flutter applications, backend services, and databases, Perform database testing using Firebase, MySQL, and MS-SQL Server , Validate SQL queries, stored procedures, relational database relationships, and data integrity , Identify data synchronization issues, duplicate records, missing records, and incorrect data transactions, Verify backend integrations and ensure that application data is correctly stored, retrieved, updated, and deleted. Defect Management and Documentation Identify, document, classify, and report application defects with appropriate severity and priority. Provide clear defect descriptions, reproducible steps, screenshots, screen recordings, and supporting logs. Collaborate with developers to troubleshoot and resolve identified issues. Perform defect retesting and regression testing after bug fixes. Maintain test execution reports, defect tracking logs, test evidence, and QA documentation. Communicate testing progress, risks, dependencies, and unresolved issues to the Product Owner. Maintain comprehensive technical and functional testing documentation. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience building and maintaining scalable automation frameworks using Playwright with JavaScript, along with strong expertise in API testing using Postman and Swagger/OpenAPI. The candidate will work closely with developers, product owners, and QA engineers to establish effective quality engineering practices, automate critical business flows, identify defects early in the development lifecycle, and integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines. Integrate automated test suites with CI/CD pipelines and ensure tests can run reliably as part of application builds and deployments. Analyze automation failures and distinguish genuine application defects from test framework, environment, and test-data issues. Improve test stability by reducing flaky tests and unnecessary dependencies on shared test data. Collaborate closely with developers to improve application testability and shift quality activities earlier in the development lifecycle. Review automation code and establish coding, framework, and test automation standards. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to other QA/SDET engineers. Track and communicate quality risks, automation coverage, defects, and release readiness. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness , act with integrity , and are driven to help our clients succeed . We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work. Experience designing and maintaining modern UI automation frameworks. Strong understanding of Playwright capabilities including: Locators and selectors Fixtures Browser contexts Assertions Network/API handling Parallel execution Retry strategies Tracing, screenshots, and debugging Strong experience with REST API testing. Hands-on experience with Postman for API validation and automated testing. Experience using Swagger/OpenAPI specifications to understand and validate APIs. Strong understanding of: REST APIs JSON HTTP/HTTPS Authentication and authorization HTTP methods and status codes Request/response validation Experience with Git and modern source-control practices. Experience integrating automated tests with CI/CD platforms such as GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins. Strong understanding of test design techniques, defect lifecycle, regression testing, integration testing, and risk-based testing. Strong debugging, root-cause analysis, and troubleshooting skills. Experience working in Agile/Scrum product development teams. Preferences: Experience testing backend APIs and distributed/microservices-based applications. Experience with SQL/database validation. Experience with performance or load-testing tools such as JMeter or k6. Understanding of accessibility and security testing concepts. Experience with reporting tools and automation results/metrics. Core Competencies: Make technical decisions about what should and should not be automated. Design automation that is stable, reusable, and maintainable. Identify quality risks across UI, APIs, integrations, environments, and test data. Establish engineering standards and conduct automation code reviews. description: In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward. Google is an engineering company at heart. We hire people with a broad set of technical skills who are ready to take on some of technology's greatest challenges and make an impact on users around the world. At Google, engineers not only revolutionize search, they routinely work on scalability and storage solutions, large-scale applications and entirely new platforms for developers around the world. From Google Ads to Chrome, Android to YouTube, social to local, Google engineers are changing the world one technological achievement after another. Responsibilities Write product or system development code. title: Experience Designer
description: Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively. We are looking for a UX Designer to create meaningful, user-centered digital experiences from discovery through delivery. You will translate customer needs and business goals into intuitive product solutions, collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, and use AI-powered tools to enhance the speed and quality of design work. What you will do Design user-centered experiences across the end-to-end product lifecycle, from discovery and ideation to delivery and iteration, simplifying complex medical-grade capabilities into intuitive experiences for Hearing Care Professionals and consumers. Conduct user research, stakeholder interviews, usability testing, and insight synthesis to inform design decisions. Create workflows, wireframes, interactive prototypes, journey maps, service blueprints, and other design artefacts that guide product development. Partner with product managers, engineers, researchers, and business stakeholders to balance customer needs, business objectives, and technical constraints. Apply UX, service design, and systems-thinking methodologies to solve complex customer and business challenges. Advocate for the needs of Hearing Care Professionals and consumers throughout the product lifecycle. Contribute to design systems, UI standards, and best practices that promote consistency, usability, accessibility, and scalability. Collaborate with front-end developers to ensure designs are feasible, responsive, accessible, and aligned with UI component libraries and design tokens. Understand the software development process, including Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, backlog refinement, developer handoff, QA, and continuous improvement. Leverage AI-powered tools and techniques to enhance research synthesis, ideation, content generation, prototyping, usability analysis, and overall design effectiveness. What you'll bring 3+ years of experience in UX Design, Product Design, Experience Design, Service Design, or a related discipline. Experience designing digital products, software applications, or service experiences. Strong skills in interaction design, workflow design, information architecture, visual communication, and prototyping. Experience conducting research and translating insights into effective, actionable design solutions. Understanding of customer journeys, service design, systems thinking, and experience strategy. Experience working in Agile, cross-functional product teams. Proficiency with Figma, including modern design, prototyping, and collaboration workflows. Hands-on experience using Figma AI to accelerate design exploration, component creation, layout generation, or design-system workflows. Experience using enterprise AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT Enterprise for research synthesis, user-story creation, journey mapping, content ideation, usability-test planning, and design documentation. Working knowledge of UI design principles, responsive layouts, accessibility standards, and front-end implementation considerations such as HTML/CSS structure, component-based design, and design handoff. Familiarity with development processes and tools commonly used in Agile product teams, including Jira, Confluence, version-controlled design handoffs, and collaboration with engineering teams. Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills. A portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design work, research-led decision-making, and measurable impact. Nice to have Experience in healthcare, medical devices, B2B SaaS, or regulated digital products. Familiarity with accessibility standards such as WCAG and inclusive-design practices. Experience contributing to or maintaining a design system. Exposure to front-end frameworks or low-code platforms, with the ability to communicate effectively with developers. Experience using AI responsibly, including validating AI-generated outputs and protecting sensitive customer or business data. Preferred AI-tool experience Figma AI: Rapid ideation, UI exploration, prototyping, design-system support, and production-ready design workflows. Claude: Research synthesis, stakeholder-input analysis, user-story refinement, journey mapping, and structured design documentation. ChatGPT Enterprise: Ideation, usability-test planning, content design, insight clustering, and cross-functional collaboration support. Who we are At WSA, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services. Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world. With us, you will become part of a truly global company where we care for one another, welcome diversity and celebrate our successes. Sounds wonderful? We can't wait to hear from you. WSA is an equal-opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for all. Regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status we firmly believe that our work is at its best when everyone feels free to be their most authentic self.

Day to day, that might mean reviewing a pull request, keeping Figma and code in step, untangling a tricky UI issue or writing the specs and agent instructions that help teams get the UI right the first time. Document design decisions, approved patterns and reusable fixes for recurring problems. Write design system release notes and tell development teams about component changes. title: Web GIS Application Developer - Senior Associate

Innovation & AI-Driven Development: Experience using AI-assisted tools like GitHub Copilot / Cursor for code generation, validation, and optimization. Knowledge of automated testing frameworks and code quality tools (e.g., PHPStan, PHPUnit, ESLint). Proactive in leveraging automation and AI to improve development speed, maintainability, and reliability. Collaboration & Leadership: Excellent communicator with the ability to collaborate effectively across UI/UX, QA, Product, and client-facing teams. Skilled in mentoring developers, conducting code reviews, and upholding technical standards. Strong problem-solving, debugging, and performance optimization mindset. Detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and quality focus. Solutions-focused under pressure — realistic yet optimistic. Confident communicator who thrives in collaborative, fast-paced environments. Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). 7+ years of professional experience in ecommerce development, with 4+ years of hands-on experience in BigCommerce. Experience with BigCommerce Multi-Storefront, B2B Edition, and Headless Commerce implementations. Solid understanding of REST/GraphQL APIs, ERP/CRM integrations, and microservices architecture. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git, and modern development workflows. Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) and automated testing frameworks. Demonstrated ability to mentor developers, conduct code reviews, and uphold technical standards. Excellent communication and collaboration skills across cross-functional teams. Collaborate directly with cross-functional teams and leadership to influence Kensium’s technical roadmap. Shape best practices in AI-assisted development and modern frameworks.
